title: metrics-gateway MCP surface v1
description: The tools, resources and HTTP surface metrics-gateway serves. Producer: metrics-gateway, whose CI diffs its live tools/list against `tools` below (name, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations). Consumer: chatbot-backend's metrics spoke. contracts/README.md § 'The metrics spoke' holds the rules no schema can state.

x-transport.mode: Stateless with JSON responses: a request carrying `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` gets one `application/json` JSON-RPC response, and `tools/call`, `tools/list`, `resources/read` need no prior `initialize` and no `Mcp-Session-Id`. `initialize` still works for clients that send it.
x-transport.auth: None. The gateway is reachable only inside the cluster network, and only from the backend (contracts/README.md § 'The metrics spoke').

GET /healthz.description: Liveness, and the release each project is serving. 200 from the moment the process listens, with or without a release; a project with no release yet is absent from `projects`. Not traced.

x-errors.description: A refused or failed tool call is a JSON-RPC result with `isError: true` and `structuredContent` = #/$defs/ToolError. Never a JSON-RPC error object, except for an unknown tool name or malformed JSON-RPC. The code is the contract; the message is for people and may change.

codes.invalid_arguments: the arguments do not satisfy the tool's inputSchema
codes.no_release: the project has no served release yet
codes.unknown_project: project is not one the gateway serves
codes.unknown_metric: a metric name is not in the served release; `candidates` lists close names
codes.unknown_dimension: a group_by, filter or order_by name is not valid for these metrics at the served release; `candidates` lists close names
codes.unknown_saved_query: the saved query is not in the served release; `candidates` lists close names
codes.operator_not_allowed: a filter op outside the allow-list
codes.literal_refused: a filter value contains `{` or `}`, or is not a scalar
codes.values_not_indexed: get_dimension_values on a dimension not opted in with meta.index_values
codes.engine_timeout: the warehouse did not answer within the effective time limit; the query was cancelled

x-telemetry.span: One span per tools/call, named `tools/call <tool>`, refusals and timeouts included, carrying attributes `mcp.tool`, `audit.id` (= the result's audit_id), `audit.outcome` (ok | no_match | refused | timeout | error) and `metrics.sha` when a release was served. Its trace id is the result's trace_id. When the call carries a W3C `traceparent` header the span joins that trace.
x-telemetry.audit: One row in audit.tool_call per tools/call, written before the result is returned: at, tool, args, project, sha, sql, rows, ms, outcome, trace_id.

x-resources.metricflow://{project}/semantic_manifest: The semantic_manifest.json of the served release, application/json.
x-resources.metricflow://{project}/osi: The release's OSI document when the bundle carries one, application/json; resources/read returns an error when it does not.

tools.name: search_semantic
tools.description: Find the governed objects that answer a plain-language question: metrics, dimensions, entities, saved queries and dimension values, at the served release. Returns no_match when nothing clears the score floor.

no_match.description: True exactly when hits is empty.

tools.name: describe_metric
tools.description: A metric's type, readable definition, filters, the group_bys valid for it, and the saved queries that use it.

tools.name: describe_saved_query
tools.description: A saved query's metrics, group_bys, where clauses and intended use.

tools.name: get_dimension_values
tools.description: Up to 200 known values of a dimension opted in with meta.index_values, served from the index; never touches the warehouse.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Compile and run a governed metric query through MetricFlow at the served release. Read-only; at most 500 rows.

timeout_ms.description: A tighter budget than the server's limit; the effective limit is the smaller of the two.

tools.name: run_saved_query
tools.description: Run a saved query at the served release, optionally narrowed in time. Same guards and result as query_metrics.

audit_id.description: The audit row this call wrote. Opaque.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id of the call's span in Phoenix project `metrics-gateway`.

name.description: The object's MetricFlow name; for a dimension_value, the value itself.

parent.description: For a dimension_value, its dimension (e.g. customer__state); for a dimension, its semantic model.

score.description: Fused rank score. Comparable within one response only; its scale is not promised.

op.description: Allow-list: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, not_in. Deliberately a string, not an enum, so anything else reaches the gateway and is refused as operator_not_allowed rather than as a schema error.

definitions.description: Readable definition of each metric queried, keyed by name.

sql.description: The SQL MetricFlow compiled and the warehouse ran.

code.description: One of x-errors.codes; a consumer tolerates an unknown one.
